title: node.list_types
description: List node/effect types; when 'node' is given, also return that instance's parameters with their live value, default, min/max and choices. Maps 1:2 to OPP/1 section 8.5 node.list_types + node.get_params (the legacy 'list_effects' tool).

category.description: Filter by category (OPP/1 section 8.5); defaults to all.

node.description: Optional node instance id; when present the result also includes that node's parameters (min/max/choices) as returned by OPP/1 node.get_params.
